project.title: Sustainable Housing Portfolio Optimisation Initiative
project.objective: Design and roll out a sustainability-focused optimisation plan for the housing portfolio, improving occupancy, service quality, and environmental performance while controlling costs.
deliverables: Current-state assessment of housing portfolio, logistics and service operations
Sustainability and efficiency strategy for housing and related services
Green ICT roadmap for tenant and facilities digital services
Quality and compliance framework for housing operations and suppliers
Financial and KPI dashboard for monitoring portfolio performance
Implementation rollout plan with phased milestones and responsibilities
constraints: Must comply with housing, safety and data protection regulations
Limited capex budget for upgrades in the first 12 months
Minimal disruption to current tenants and service levels
Need to align with existing corporate sustainability targets
ICT changes must integrate with current core systems
Executive board expects initial results within the first quarter

risks.risk: Tenant resistance to operational or digital changes.
risks.mitigation: Run early communication, pilot in one building, gather feedback and adjust rollout.

risks.risk: ICT integration issues delay green digital initiatives.
risks.mitigation: Phase integrations, prioritise low-dependency features, involve ICT early in design.

risks.risk: Budget overruns due to underestimated retrofit or process costs.
risks.mitigation: Create conservative cost estimates, add contingency, stage investments by impact.

risks.risk: Quality or compliance gaps discovered during audits.
risks.mitigation: Run internal pre-audits, implement corrective action plans, standardise procedures.

risks.risk: Lack of alignment between sustainability goals and operational KPIs.
risks.mitigation: Co-define KPIs with leadership, embed them in dashboards and performance reviews.

themes.why_relevant: Occupancy and satisfaction drive revenue and must be protected during optimisation.
Green ICT consultant leads digital and environmental improvements across the portfolio.
Quality engineering technician ensures processes and suppliers meet standards and audits.
Business consultant and CEO need clear ROI, KPIs and budget control for the initiative.
Housing manager must coordinate staff and tenants through operational changes.
Different roles must align on priorities, trade-offs and decision-making cadence.

backlog.task: Map current housing portfolio performance, including occupancy, rent levels, and service issues
definition_of_done: All properties listed with occupancy, rent, and key service metrics
Top 10 recurring tenant issues identified and documented
Summary shared with project stakeholders and validated

backlog.task: Define target operating model and business case for sustainable housing optimisation
definition_of_done: Target operating model documented with process and governance changes
High-level financial model with cost, savings and revenue impact completed
Business case approved by chief executive officer

backlog.task: Design green ICT roadmap for tenant portals, energy monitoring and digital communication
definition_of_done: List of priority green ICT initiatives with scope and benefits
Dependencies and integration points with existing systems identified
Roadmap endorsed by housing manager and chief executive officer

backlog.task: Establish quality and compliance checklist for housing operations and suppliers
definition_of_done: Checklist drafted covering safety, service quality and sustainability criteria
Checklist piloted on at least two properties and refined
Final version approved by housing manager and business consultant

backlog.task: Create executive KPI dashboard for portfolio performance and sustainability metrics
definition_of_done: Key KPIs defined with clear formulas and data sources
Dashboard mock-up created and reviewed with chief executive officer
Agreement on monthly reporting cadence and owners

backlog.task: Prioritise buildings and services for phase 1 implementation
definition_of_done: Selection criteria defined (impact, risk, readiness)
Shortlist of phase 1 properties and services agreed
List communicated to all project stakeholders

backlog.task: Define sustainability and digital communication plan for tenants and staff
definition_of_done: Key messages and channels for tenants and staff documented
Draft communication calendar for first 3 months created
Housing manager signs off on communication plan

backlog.task: Run baseline quality and process audit on selected pilot properties
definition_of_done: Audit executed on at least two pilot properties
Findings and non-conformities documented
Action list shared with housing manager for remediation

backlog.task: Set project governance, decision rights and reporting structure
definition_of_done: Steering and working group structure defined
Decision rights and escalation paths documented
Governance document shared and acknowledged by all roles

backlog.task: Align budget envelope and phasing for the first year of the initiative
definition_of_done: Budget ranges agreed for ICT, operations and quality improvements
Phasing by quarter documented and shared
Constraints communicated to business consultant and housing manager

backlog.task: Model operational efficiency gains from logistics and process improvements
definition_of_done: Key logistics and process changes identified with housing manager
Efficiency and cost impact estimated and documented
Assumptions validated with quality engineering technician

backlog.task: Standardise incident and damage assessment process across properties
definition_of_done: Standard process for incident reporting and damage assessment defined
Process reviewed with quality engineering technician
Rollout plan for staff training drafted

threads_plan.thread_goal: Align on scope, governance and initial priorities for the initiative.
threads_plan.trigger: Kickoff message from chief executive officer announcing the project and Slack channel.

mandatory_decisions.decision: Confirm and document project scope and success metrics for the first 30 days.
Agree on governance structure and decision rights as per the charter.

threads_plan.thread_goal: Review housing portfolio baseline and select phase 1 pilot properties.
threads_plan.trigger: Housing manager shares initial baseline data and asks for feedback on pilot selection.

mandatory_decisions.decision: Approve the list of phase 1 pilot properties and services.
Lock criteria for prioritising properties for later phases.

threads_plan.thread_goal: Define and validate the green ICT roadmap and communication plan.
threads_plan.trigger: Green ICT consultant posts draft roadmap and asks for alignment with operations.

mandatory_decisions.decision: Select which green ICT initiatives will be included in phase 1.
Approve the tenant and staff communication plan for the first rollout.

threads_plan.thread_goal: Agree on quality, compliance and audit approach for pilot properties.
threads_plan.trigger: Quality engineering technician shares draft checklist and pilot audit findings.

mandatory_decisions.decision: Approve the standard quality and compliance checklist for pilots.
Decide on remediation priorities for issues found in pilot audits.

threads_plan.thread_goal: Lock budget envelope, KPI dashboard and reporting cadence.
threads_plan.trigger: Business consultant posts KPI dashboard mock-up and budget scenarios.

mandatory_decisions.decision: Confirm KPI set and dashboard structure for executive reporting.
Agree on budget allocation and phasing for the first year.

channel_rituals: Twice-weekly async standup where each role posts progress, blockers and next steps.
Weekly summary post by business consultant with KPI updates and key decisions.
Bi-weekly risk and issue review led by quality engineering technician and housing manager.
Monthly roadmap check-in led by green ICT consultant to adjust ICT and sustainability priorities.
End-of-phase retrospective thread facilitated by chief executive officer focusing on outcomes and learnings.
